integrity: The strict spectral ordering and logarithmic-squared conditioning are analytically proved. Symbolic and numerical programs independently corroborate formulas but do not certify infinite dimension claims. Historical priority has residual uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: All dimensions d>=4 but exact degree-two harmonic space only; a single oriented coordinate-dominance cell; no finite-sample reconstruction, higher-degree spectrum or elementary closed-form eigenvalues is asserted.
title: The four-sector quadratic-harmonic spectrum of coordinate-dominant spherical cells
